verses.kjv: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
verses.modern: The burden that Habakkuk the prophet saw.

verses.kjv: O LORD, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!
verses.modern: O LORD, how long shall I cry, and You will not hear? I cry out to You of violence, and You will not save.

verses.kjv: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.
verses.modern: Why do You show me iniquity, and make me look on grievance? Plundering and violence are before me, and there are those who stir up strife and contention.

verses.kjv: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.
verses.modern: Therefore the law is slack, and judgment never goes forth. The wicked surround the righteous, so wrong judgment proceeds.

verses.kjv: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
verses.modern: Look among the heathen, and consider, and be greatly amazed. For I will work a work in your days that you would not believe, even if it were told you.

verses.kjv: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.
verses.modern: I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, who march through the breadth of the land to possess dwellings that are not theirs.

verses.kjv: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
verses.modern: They are terrible and dreadful. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

verses.kjv: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.
verses.modern: Their horses are swifter than leopards and fiercer than evening wolves. Their horsemen spread themselves, and their horsemen come from far away. They fly like an eagle that hurries to eat.

verses.kjv: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
verses.modern: They all come for violence. Their faces are set like the east wind, and they gather captives like sand.

verses.kjv: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
verses.modern: They scoff at kings, and princes are a scorn to them. They mock every stronghold, for they heap up dust and take it.

verses.kjv: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.
verses.modern: Then his mind changes, and he passes over and offends, crediting his power to his god.

verses.kjv: Art thou not from everlasting, O LORD my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O LORD, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.
verses.modern: Are You not from everlasting, O LORD my God, my Holy One? We shall not die. O LORD, You have ordained them for judgment, and, O mighty God, You have established them for correction.

verses.kjv: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
verses.modern: You are of purer eyes than to look on evil, and You cannot look on iniquity. Why then do You look on those who deal treacherously, and hold Your tongue when the wicked devours the man more righteous than he?

verses.kjv: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
verses.modern: You make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them.

verses.kjv: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
verses.modern: They take all of them up with the hook. They catch them in their net and gather them in their dragnet. Therefore they rejoice and are glad.

verses.kjv: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.
verses.modern: Therefore they sacrifice to their net and burn incense to their dragnet, because by them their portion is rich and their food plentiful.

verses.kjv: Shall he therefore empty his net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
verses.modern: Shall they therefore empty their net, and continually slay the nations without mercy?

chapters.summary: Habakkuk cries out to the LORD: "How long shall I cry, and You will not hear?" Violence and wickedness surround him. The LORD answers: He is raising up the Chaldeans — a bitter and swift nation — to execute judgment. Habakkuk is astonished: How can a holy God use a nation more wicked than Judah to punish them?

verses.kjv: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
verses.modern: I will stand on my watch and station myself on the tower. I will watch to see what He will say to me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.

verses.kjv: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
verses.modern: The LORD answered me and said, "Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, so that He who reads it may run.

verses.kjv: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
verses.modern: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie. Though it waits, wait for it, because it will surely come; it will not delay.

verses.kjv: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.
verses.modern: His soul that is lifted up is not upright in Him, but the just shall live by His faith.

verses.kjv: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:
verses.modern: Also, because He transgresses by wine, He is a proud man, and He does not stay at home. He enlarges His desire as hell, and is like death, and cannot be satisfied. He gathers all nations to Himself and heaps to Himself all peoples.

verses.kjv: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
verses.modern: Shall not all these take up a parable against Him, and a taunting proverb against Him, and say, "Woe to Him who increases what is not His! How long? And to Him who loads Himself with thick clay!"

verses.kjv: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
verses.modern: Shall they not rise up suddenly who will bite You, and awake who will trouble You? Then You shall become their plunder.

verses.kjv: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
verses.modern: Because You have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the people shall plunder you. This is because of men's blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city, and to all who live in it.

verses.kjv: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!
verses.modern: Woe to Him who covets an evil covetousness for His house, that He may set His nest on high, that He may be delivered from the power of evil!

verses.kjv: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.
verses.modern: You have brought shame to Your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against Your own soul.

verses.kjv: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
verses.modern: The stone shall cry out from the wall, and the beam from the timber shall answer it.

verses.kjv: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!
verses.modern: Woe to Him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!

verses.kjv: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
verses.modern: Is it not from the LORD of hosts that the people shall labor in the fire, and the people shall weary themselves for nothing?

verses.kjv: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.modern: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

verses.kjv: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
verses.modern: Woe to Him who gives His neighbor drink, who puts His bottle to Him and makes Him drunk also, so that He may look on their nakedness!

verses.kjv: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD's right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.
verses.modern: You are filled with shame instead of glory. Drink also Yourself, and let Your foreskin be uncovered. The cup of the LORD's right hand shall be turned to You, and shameful vomit shall be on Your glory.

verses.kjv: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
verses.modern: The violence done to Lebanon shall cover You, and the destruction of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men's blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city, and to all who live in it.

verses.kjv: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
verses.modern: What profit is the carved image, that its maker has carved it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of His work trusts in it, to make mute idols?

verses.kjv: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
verses.modern: Woe to Him who says to the wood, "Awake!" — to the mute stone, "Arise, it shall teach!" It is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.

verses.kjv: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
verses.modern: But the LORD is in His holy temple. Let all the earth keep silence before Him.

chapters.summary: Habakkuk stands on his watchtower to wait for the LORD's answer. The LORD replies: "Write the vision and make it plain — the just shall live by his faith." Five woes follow against the arrogant conqueror — for plundering nations, building by bloodshed, filling the earth with violence, shaming his neighbor, and trusting in idols. "The earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea."

verses.kjv: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.
verses.modern: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, on Shigionoth.

verses.kjv: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
verses.modern: O LORD, I have heard Your speech, and I was afraid. O LORD, revive Your work in the midst of the years; in the midst of the years make it known. In wrath remember mercy.

verses.kjv: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.
verses.modern: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of His praise.

verses.kjv: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.
verses.modern: His brightness was like the light. He had rays coming out of His hand, and there was the hiding of His power.

verses.kjv: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.
verses.modern: Before Him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at His feet.

verses.kjv: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.
verses.modern: He stood and measured the earth. He looked and drove apart the nations. The everlasting mountains were scattered, and the perpetual hills bowed down. His ways are everlasting.

verses.kjv: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
verses.modern: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction, and the curtains of the land of Midian trembled.

verses.kjv: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?
verses.modern: Was the LORD displeased with the rivers? Was Your anger against the rivers? Was Your wrath against the sea, that You rode on Your horses and Your chariots of salvation?

verses.kjv: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
verses.modern: Your bow was made quite bare, according to the oaths of the tribes, even Your word. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.

verses.kjv: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
verses.modern: The mountains saw You and trembled. The overflowing of the water passed by. The deep uttered its voice, and lifted up its hands on high.

verses.kjv: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.
verses.modern: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation. At the light of Your arrows they went, and at the shining of Your glittering spear.

verses.kjv: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.
verses.modern: You marched through the land in indignation. You threshed the heathen in anger.

verses.kjv: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.
verses.modern: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, for salvation with Your anointed. You wounded the head of the house of the wicked, uncovering the foundation up to the neck. Selah.

verses.kjv: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
verses.modern: You struck through with his own staves the head of his villages. They came out like a whirlwind to scatter me. Their rejoicing was as if to devour the poor secretly.

verses.kjv: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.
verses.modern: You walked through the sea with Your horses, through the heap of great waters.

verses.kjv: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
verses.modern: When I heard, my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled within myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble. When he comes up against the people, he will invade them with his troops.

verses.kjv: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
verses.modern: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, and there shall be no fruit on the vines; though the labor of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no food; though the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls —

verses.kjv: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
verses.modern: yet I will rejoice in the LORD; I will joy in the God of my salvation.

verses.kjv: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
verses.modern: The Lord GOD is my strength. He will make my feet like hinds' feet, and He will make me to walk on my high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

chapters.summary: Habakkuk prays in awe, remembering the LORD's mighty works — His glory covers the heavens, pestilence goes before Him, and He marches through the earth in indignation. Though the fig tree does not blossom, the vines fail, and the fields yield no food, yet Habakkuk will rejoice in the LORD and joy in the God of his salvation.
